This scene:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 一看很多人正在吃一些植物：看到，一……就
- 神农想帮别人：帮他们，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，This time expression is not idiomatic here; use “在古代” or “古代” to introduce the historical setting.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一看很多人正在吃一些植物：看到很多人正在吃一些植物，“看” means to look, while “看到” means to see; this sentence describes what Shen Nong saw.

items.reason: “古代的时候” redundantly combines a time period with 的时候; “在古代” is correct.
“看” should be “看到” for a completed perception here, and removing 一 avoids the required 一……就 structure.
